gloss: loading; now loading; reading in progress

definitions.gloss: loading; now loading; reading in progress
definitions.explanation: Commonly seen on screens while data is being loaded

examples.japanese: {画面|がめん}に「{読|よ}み{込|こ}み{中|ちゅう}」と{表示|ひょうじ}された。
データ{読|よ}み{込|こ}み{中|ちゅう}はパソコンの{電源|でんげん}を{切|き}らないでください。
examples.english: Please do not turn off the computer while data is loading.

examples.japanese: ファイルの{読|よ}み{込|こ}み{中|ちゅう}にエラーが{発生|はっせい}したため、もう{一度|いちど}{試|ため}してください。
examples.english: An error occurred while loading the file, so please try again.

notes:
A compound of {読|よ}み{込|こ}み (reading/loading data) + {中|ちゅう} (in progress). This is the standard Japanese equivalent of "Now Loading" seen on computer screens, apps, and game consoles. The term {読|よ}み{込|こ}み literally means "reading in" — the metaphor of a computer "reading" data from storage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- データ{読|よ}み{込|こ}み{中|ちゅう}: data loading in progress
- ページ{読|よ}み{込|こ}み{中|ちゅう}: page loading
- {読|よ}み{込|こ}み{中|ちゅう}...しばらくお{待|ま}ちください: loading... please wait a moment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ローディング: loading (English loanword; also common on screens)
- {書|か}き{込|こ}み{中|ちゅう}: writing in progress (the reverse operation — saving data)
- {処理中|しょりちゅう}: processing (broader term for any ongoing computation)
- {準備中|じゅんびちゅう}: preparing (used for services/shops not yet ready, not for data)

PATTERN:
The suffix {中|ちゅう} attaches to many action nouns to mean "in the middle of doing X": {工事中|こうじちゅう} (under construction), {営業中|えいぎょうちゅう} (open for business), {充電中|じゅうでんちゅう} (charging).
